description: baseline

Attack the dominant n=512/1024 large-batch shapes with blocked right-looking Householder QR using the compact-WY representation, batched ACROSS all matrices. A Triton kernel factors each b-column panel (b~32-64) for ALL matrices at once (one CTA per matrix's panel => 640 CTAs in flight = full occupancy, the lever cuSOLVER misses) and forms the b x b triangular T factor; apply the block reflector A := A - V T (V^T A) to the trailing submatrix as batched torch.bmm GEMMs (tensor cores). Keep GEMM in cuBLAS/bmm, NOT Triton (cuBLAS wins flops). The ONLY mandatory-Triton part is the batched panel factorization. Far fewer, larger launches than cuSOLVER's per-matrix path. Use LAPACK reflector/sign/zero-column convention; emit FP32 (H,tau) exactly like geqrf. Route off-grid n to torch.geqrf; avoid substring 'stream'.

Blocked right-looking Householder QR with compact-WY: batched Triton panel-factorization kernel (one CTA per matrix's panel, geqr2 over nb=32 cols, LAPACK sign/tail-norm-zero convention) + Triton LARFT T-factor kernel + torch.bmm trailing update. Supported n={32,176,352,512,1024,2048,4096}. 5.36x: 116914->21814us. n=512 B640 shape 45x faster (963k->21k); but n=2048/4096 LOW-batch regressed badly (B2/B8 -> poor occupancy).

Narrow custom path to n<={32,176,352,512,1024}; route n=2048/4096 to torch.geqrf where cuSOLVER's blocked path saturates the device and the one-CTA-per-matrix occupancy lever has too few matrices (B2/B8). 8.54x: 116914->13683us. n=2048 50412us, n=4096 74750us back to cuSOLVER speed. Validate PASS, all 3 guards CLEAN.

Fuse trailing-update subtraction into GEMM via torch.baddbmm (beta=1,alpha=-1), eliminating the 34%-of-kernel-time standalone elementwise C-= pass. Panel kernel now also emits a clean unit-lower-trapezoidal V buffer, removing per-panel torch.tril + diagonal index_put. 10.3x: 13683->11313us. n=512 21191->15576us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN. n=1024 unchanged (90827us) - different bottleneck, profile next.

Regime-dependent panel width nb: profile showed _panel_factor_kernel is 93% of n=1024 time (batch=60 => only 60 CTAs, sequential per-panel work dominates). nb=16 halves resident-panel size & sequential column depth => n=1024 90827->15197us (6x). n<=512 keeps nb=32 (full occupancy amortizes launch/T tail). 16.2x overall: 11313->7205us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN.

Two-level right-looking blocked QR: profile showed trailing-update GEMMs are now 60-80% of time (FP32 SIMT, skinny inner dim nb). Inner panels (nb) accumulate into a wide outer compact-WY block (NB=64 for n>=512); the expensive trailing update on cols right of the block becomes ONE wide reflector (GEMM inner dim NB=64, not nb=16/32). Within-block small updates + extract_unit_lower kernel + combined T. Small-n (n<512) stays single-level (too little trailing work). Also tested TF32 on the GEMMs: FAILS correctness (proj TF32 catastrophic, update TF32 sf=14.9>1.0) so trailing GEMMs stay FP32. 18.7x: 7205->6238us. n=512 14655, n=1024 11000us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN.

Set inner nb=16 for n>=512 (was 32 for n=512). Two-level blocking decouples the trailing GEMM (inner dim NB=64) from the inner panel width, so the cheaper narrow panel kernel now wins for n=512 too (nb=16+NB=64=12495us vs nb=32+NB=64=14655). 19.9x: 6238->5870us. n=512 12495, n=1024 11038us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN.

Replace sequential Triton form_T recurrence (was 18% of n=512) with closed-form batched triangular solve: T=diag(tau)@U^-1 where U=I+striu(VtV,1)*tau[col] (unit-upper), via torch.linalg.solve_triangular. Verified machine-precision-equal incl rank-deficient/tau=0. n=512 12495->12030us (T cheaper). BUT n=1024 (11038->11375) and small-n (176:440->544) regressed from per-block solve launch overhead with many small blocks. Net slight regression 5870->5949us. Cleaner code (removed a kernel). Validate PASS, guards CLEAN. Will continue from the faster Triton-T state.
Tune panel kernel num_warps per regime (sweep: n=512 best at nw=4, n=1024 best at nw=8; Triton default was suboptimal). n=1024 11038->10008us. 20.4x: 5870->5742us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN.

Hybrid compact-WY T: closed-form batched triangular solve (T=diag(tau)(I+striu(VtV)tau)^-1) for the WIDE combined outer block (NB>=48, where it beats the O(NB^3) Triton recurrence), and the cheap Triton LARFT recurrence for the NARROW inner within-block + small-n blocks (where solve_triangular's per-call overhead loses). Best of both. 21.5x: 5742->5449us. n=512 12497->11374, n=1024 10008->9400us. Validate PASS, guards CLEAN.

The stable single-launch alternative is forward-substitution = the slow recurrence. So the cuBLAS trsm is the right STABLE+fast choice; the T-solve is settled at the leaner-construction win. The VtV bmm (100us) is inherent (no batched upper-only SYRK in torch).
